source_audit.primary_text: Pyramid Text 216, Neith recension, TLA Text ID OTBBZXXL6RHX5MQPVDFAPKQPAE
sequence: 151a: Sꜣḥ/Orion is encircled by the Duat while the Living One is purified in the horizon
151b: Sothis is described through the parallel Duat/horizon construction
151c: Neith is described through the same Duat/horizon construction
151d-e: the subject becomes ꜣḫ in the ensuing sequence

independent_identity_links.note: Later divine-name attestation; not used to back-project a lexical identity into PT216.
Kept lexically distinct from Sꜣḥ Orion.

operator_revision.reason: PT216 supports an external named celestial anchor participating in the same transformation context; it does not support Orion = transfiguration as a lexical identity.
operator_revision.modern_hypothesis: A stable named external state anchor may bind multiple changing/erased active representations to one provenance-bearing durable state, but the binding must be cryptographic/replayable and must never be inferred from label similarity alone.
